name: Computer Science
description: Computer science programmes teach how computation works and how to build software that is correct, efficient and maintainable — algorithms, data structures, operating systems, networks, languages and the discrete mathematics underneath them. It is the largest computing programme in Florida by any measure, and the one with the widest spread of entry points.
degreesNote: Florida awards computing credentials at every level: short state-college certificates, an A.S. or A.A., the bachelor’s degree that most software work expects, and master’s and doctoral degrees above it. ⚠ Ask the transfer question early, because it is the one that costs people a year: an A.S. in a computing field is a CAREER degree built to lead to work, and it does not always transfer into a university computer science bachelor’s — the A.A. route normally does. ⚠ Accreditation for computing comes from ABET’s COMPUTING commission, not its engineering commission, and nothing in software employment requires it; there is no licence in this field.

cips.note: Computer Science — the specific federal code, and ⚠ only four Florida public institutions file under it, which is why it cannot be the whole of this programme.

Computer and Information Sciences, General — where Florida actually files most of its computing awards: 41 public institutions, including essentially every state college that teaches computing. ⚠ Included deliberately. Defining this programme by 11.07 alone would list four institutions and hide the ones where most Florida students begin.

related.note: ⚠ The hardware side of the same boundary, and usually an engineering degree rather than a computing one — which changes the accrediting body and the mathematics. If embedded systems, chips or robotics are the draw, compare the two directly.

The overlap is large and growing: both teach programming and algorithms, but data science adds statistics, machine learning and study design. ⚠ Read both if analytics is the goal — at many institutions the difference is four or five courses.
The inference half of data work, and the part a computing degree covers least. A statistics minor or double major on a computing degree is the combination most data job adverts are describing.
